titulo: Three ways to ask a name again
caption:
Three ways to ask a name again

I used to bluff my way through a name I had forgotten. Then I started asking for it again.

Most people would rather repeat their name once than be met by someone pretending, and asking early is the easiest moment.

For whoever asks for the name again.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure, in three labeled scenes. The guess: a teal figure says hey, buddy! and the blue one narrows its eyes. The bluff: a brown figure nods, wide-eyed and trembling, saying yep, yep. The ask: an ink-black figure leans in and says your name again?, and the blue one's eyes turn happy. The text stays: three kinds of forgetting names. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
